name: Daldaki Siesta
scene: A relaxed sloth hangs from a sweeping branch amid lush tropical leaves.
notes: Design sheet only; target 91–131 panes. Warm copper/gold sloth and cool green/turquoise branch and foliage use separate colour pairs. Inspired by vitray fox and poppy design sheets and the original story_sloth subject. Generated twice; selected second version after visual review. Closed facial panes replace the first attempt’s dangling mouth stroke; opaque white exterior and oval rim. Remaining concerns for tracing: some multi-way foliage contacts (especially upper-left and lower foliage), narrow tapered fur pieces, adjacent same-colour background panes and slight fill tonal variation. Pane count and junction geometry are not yet mechanically validated.
